text: Free demo where you drive an armed snowplow through a possessed toy apocalypse.
Shoot down incoming candy and ornaments, then charge up and ram through everything.
There's a candy-cane minigun and a tinsel laser, and every weapon overheats if you get greedy.
Best moment: a giant stitched-up teddy bear boss.
The catch? The big yellow explosions look flat, and they hide the action.
The whole demo is about three hundred megabytes, English only, and the full game has five winter regions.
Think Heavy Weapon, with Christmas gone wrong.
Worth a dip. Santa's bad list needs road work.
